mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer sector, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 0% change and RSAFS < 0% change in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals the central bank's commitment to combat inflation, leading to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month signals strong economic momentum, compressing discount rates and stimulating equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak GDP growth (GDPC1 below 1.0% annualized) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS not declining) signals a dual threat of economic stagnation and monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS not declining
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 is below 1.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
